citations.narrative:
Potable water was not provided as often as necessary for the health and comfort of two (2) Three-Banded Armadillos.
The only water receptacle for both animals was turned over onto its side and empty. APHIS Officials requested that water
be provided to the animals. The facility representative refilled the water receptacle; when the refilled water receptacle was
placed in the enclosure, both armadillos moved quickly towards the receptacle. One animal pushed the other out of the
way to begin drinking. One animal drank vigorously for approximately five (5) minutes. The facility representative stated
that the water had been refilled that morning, and that a secondary water receptacle had been attached to the outside of
the primary enclosure. The facility representative was unable to find the secondary water receptacle. Failure to provide
sufficient quantities of potable water can result in dehydration, illness or death to the animals. The facility must provide
sufficient water as necessary for the health and comfort of the animals.
A complete routine inspection was conducted starting on September 1, 2026. This inspection report is limited to the Direct
non-compliances identified during that inspection. An additional inspection report will be delivered with the other issues
identified during this inspection.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the authorized person.
Additional Inspectors:
Sarah Roloff n
